items.context: just under 90 hours - and kcd2 main story finished! that was tons of fun!! 😊 im looking forward to doing side quests and dlc that i seem to have purchased last year, when i first got it on sale on steam. LOL it only took me a year to play it!
items.text: Congrats on finishing the main story! Playing it a year after a sale purchase is a very normal backlog pace. Enjoy the side quests and DLC.
